<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Year : </strong>2026 &#124; <strong>Size :</strong> 63 MB</p>
<p>In this can't-miss follow-up to the first EXQUISITE CORPSES series, Laura and her fellow survivors, Xavi and Jason, have attempted to carve out an existence with her winnings, far away from the evil machinations of the 13 Families. But, two years after the unfathomable events unleashed in their hometown and Laura's game-winning performance as the Last Gunman, all that they did to survive still haunts them. Now, the legacy of the golden mask refuses to stay silent... and their lives are in danger once again.</p>
